translated_title: Mexico Consolidates as the Second-Largest Exporter of AI Inputs, Behind Only China, According to the World Bank
original_title: México se consolida como el segundo exportador de insumos para IA, solo detrás de China: Banco Mundial
author: Dora Villanueva
meta_description: The World Bank ranks Mexico second only to China in AI-input exports, even as adoption lags at home and a third of Mexicans are more worried than excited about it.
